Aircon Chemical Overhaul

Our chemical overhaul service is designed for air-conditioning units that need a deeper clean than normal servicing.

We dismantle and clean the relevant indoor-unit components, wash away accumulated dirt and grime, and clean the evaporator coil and blower components before reassembly.
